title: Leadville Trail 100 Run — archived event page (traditional 11-station course, 2025 rundown cutoffs and crew/pacer layout)
claims: The archived event page lists 11 aid stations on the traditional course: Mayqueen outbound 12.4 mi cutoff 7:45am; Outward Bound outbound 23.3 mi cutoff 10:00am; Half Pipe outbound 29.2 mi cutoff 11:30am; Twin Lakes Village outbound 37.9 mi cutoff 1:30pm; Hope Pass outbound 43.1 mi cutoff 4:00pm; Winfield turnaround 49.8 mi cutoff 6:00pm; Hope Pass inbound 56.7 mi with no inbound cutoff; Twin Lakes Village inbound 61.8 mi cutoff 10:15pm; Half Pipe inbound 70.3 mi cutoff 1:15am; Outward Bound inbound 76.2 mi cutoff 3:00am; Mayqueen inbound 87.2 mi cutoff 6:30am; finish cutoff 10:00am Sunday.

The archived course profile states 99.7 miles, 15,492 feet elevation gain, 9,206 feet lowest point and 12,526 feet highest point; the overview text gives low point 9,200 feet and high point Hope Pass 12,600 feet; pacers are allowed after the 62-mile point.

The archived page lists four official crewing locations: Outward Bound, Pipeline, Twin Lakes Village and Mayqueen; crewing outside these four may disqualify the runner; Twin Lakes is shuttle-only; Mayqueen crew access is inbound only, begins 5:00pm, allows 4 crew plus 1 pacer, and traffic moves clockwise around the lake accessed from the south/Turquoise Lake dam side.

The archived pacer section: pacers start at Twin Lakes inbound mile 61.8; each runner receives 2 pacer bibs; extra bibs can be picked up at Twin Lakes, Half Pipe, Outward Bound or Mayqueen; Half Pipe has no vehicle access and requires hiking or biking in; pacers may not pace by vehicle or bicycle, take aid from vehicles, or camp overnight.

The archived drop-bag list covers Mayqueen, Outward Bound, Half Pipe, Twin Lakes and Winfield; drop-off was Friday 8/15/25 11:00am-5:00pm at 316 Harrison Ave; return Sunday about 8:00am-5:00pm; unclaimed bags are donated to local charities and are not mailed.

The archived 2026 reference schedule shows the mandatory athlete meeting Friday 10:00am, packet pickup Friday 11:00am-5:00pm, a 4:00am Saturday start, and Sunday 12:00pm awards at Lake County High School Football Field.
